hooks.command: bash -c 'root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo "{}"; exit 0; }; changed=$(git -C "$root" diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null; git -C "$root" diff --name-only --cached 2>/dev/null); if echo "$changed" | grep -qE "^(src/|package\.json|\.github/workflows/)" && ! echo "$changed" | grep -qE "^(README\.md|CHANGELOG\.md|CLAUDE\.md|\.claude/)"; then echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"[keep-docs-current] Code changed but docs (README/CHANGELOG/.claude/) were not updated this session. Consider running /docs-sync before wrapping.\"}"; else echo "{}"; fi'
